provenance.notes: Very-challenging-tier set (08-PROPOSALS.md Set 8, APPROVED 2026-09-26): folic acid + thyroxine. Per-record citation per U1: 'PubChem Identifier: CID <CID>; URL: https://pubchem.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/compound/<CID>'. Complex reference metadata: CC0 1.0 (wwPDB). AMENDED 2026-10-05 (human PHYSIOLOGICAL-PROTONATION decision '2 go R1-R8', 08.1-08 protonation audit rows 13-14, directive: 'per our spec we want to assume physiological pH normally'): folic acid CID 135398658 neutral -> folate(2-) CID 135761165 (pKa 3.5/4.3 carboxylic moieties, /Estimated/ SPARC Hilal et al. 1994 via the CID record - estimated but robust: both pKas far below 7.4) and thyroxine CID 5819 free acid/amine -> L-thyroxine zwitterion CID 25201348 (COO-/NH3+ net 0; HSDB sections in the CID 5819 record, estimated pKa 7.43/9.43: 'levothyroxine will exist in the zwitterion form ... at pH values of 5 to 9'; phenolic OH KEPT - the ~50% phenolate coexisting microstate is recorded honestly in the audit). Heavy atoms unchanged (32/24 - bucket assignments MEDIUM/small unchanged); the iodine 4x C-I halogen case is UNCHANGED.

Folate(2-), PubChem CID 135761165 (C19H17N7O6^2-, 32 heavy per approved C2 correction from research's 38; Charge -2 as recorded: 2x M CHG -1 on the glutamyl-tail carboxylates; (2S) stereo preserved; approval-time re-verification MATCH 2026-09-26 for the prior neutral form, counts 51/53). Complex: 4KMZ human folate receptor beta (FOLR2)-folate (FOL confirmed in nonpolymer inventory; K/Cl ions also present, 2026-09-26); entry DOI resolves 200; primary paper DOI 10.1073/pnas.1308827110 VERIFIED at rcsb.org (doi.org = 403 bot-block, U2 - recorded at rcsb and transcribed honestly). Interaction profile: salt_bridge (two deprotonated glutamyl-tail carboxylates - the physiological dianion), h_bond prolific (pterin N/NH donors + acceptors, carboxylate O acceptors), pi_stacking x2 (pterin + p-aminobenzoate), hydrophobic, cation_pi (AA-cation-over-rings). The vitamin; medium-bucket mass atop two coplanar-ish ring systems. AMENDED 2026-10-05 (human decision '2 go R1-R8', audit row 13/R6, directive 'per our spec we want to assume physiological pH normally'): was CID 135398658 neutral free acid (Charge 0 as recorded per the Decision-5-parallel policy: tail COOHs NOT salt-bridge-typed; 51 atoms {1:42,2:11}); swapped to folate(2-) (pKa 3.5/4.3 on the carboxylic moieties, /Estimated/ SPARC Hilal et al. 1994 via the CID record - ESTIMATED values, honestly labeled; the dianion conclusion robust since both pKas are far below 7.4). Neutral CID 135398658 record stays in git history.

Thyroxine (LT4) zwitterion, PubChem CID 25201348 (C15H11I4NO4, 24 heavy per approved C2 correction from research's 21; Charge 0 NET as recorded: 2x M CHG [-1,+1]; approval-time re-verification MATCH 2026-09-26 for the prior form, counts 35/36 identity-preserved). Complex: 2RIW reactive-loop-cleaved human thyroxine-binding globulin + thyroxine (T44 confirmed - chemcomp name queried: T44 = 3,5,3',5'-TETRAIODO-L-THYRONINE, 2026-09-26); entry DOI + primary paper DOI 10.1074/jbc.M110.171082 both resolve 200 (VERIFIED 2026-09-26). THE IODINE HALOGEN CASE: 4x C-I donors in one ligand (iodine count cross-checked against the proposal evidence: C15H11I4NO4 = exactly 4 iodines, all ring-bound aryl halogen donors) - I is in the approved halogen donor list (Cl/Br/I; C-F excluded per DETECT-03); the heaviest-halogen stress case beside chloramphenicol's Cl debut. Also h_bond (phenolic OH donor KEPT - the chosen microstate is phenol, not phenolate; carboxylate O acceptors; NH3+ donor), pi_stacking (2 aryl rings), hydrophobic. Salt-bridge coverage: the zwitterion types BOTH signs ('-' carboxylate + '+' alpha-NH3+, the latter also structurally via the ammonium rule). Feeds Decision 8 (DETECT-03 revisit trigger). AMENDED 2026-10-05 (human decision '2 go R1-R8', audit row 14/R7, directive 'per our spec we want to assume physiological pH normally'): was CID 5819 neutral free acid + free amine (Charge 0 as recorded, head NH2 + COOH; 35 atoms {1:29,2:7}, counts identity-preserved); swapped to the L-thyroxine zwitterion CID 25201348 (COO-/NH3+ via 2x M CHG [-1,+1], net 0; HSDB sections in the CID 5819 record - ESTIMATED pKa 7.43/9.43, repeated x3 annotations: 'levothyroxine will exist in the zwitterion form ... at pH values of 5 to 9'; the phenolic pKa ~7.43 sits at the physiological edge so the ~50% phenolate minus-net-1 microstate honestly coexists - phenol RETAINED per the audit's chosen state). Free-acid CID 5819 record stays in git history. THYROXINE KEEPS 24 heavy - one below the SIZE_S1=25 boundary, small bucket unchanged.
